lines: Where the road ends, the table begins.
Harbor and Vine. A kitchen on the edge of the Atlantic.
Every morning, the boats decide the menu.
Twelve courses. One long table. The sun does the rest.
Wine from the hill behind us. Bread from the oven beside you.
Open Thursday to Sunday. Book the table, not a time. You'll want the whole evening.
Harbor and Vine. Come hungry. Leave slowly.
music: Cinematic, warm and slow-building: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft strings and a gentle brushed-drum pulse, coastal and elegant, 84 BPM, steady tempo, swells at the end, no vocals.
